workshop_summary: Objective: determine Dedicated GPU reservation to meet steady-state QPS with defined peak headroom and p95/p99 latency SLOs.
Observed baseline: steady-state ~45 QPS (avg), burst patterns show 200 QPS short spikes during market open windows.
Avg tokens per request: 120 tokens (user+assistant). Steady-state token/sec calc: 45 QPS * 120 = 5,400 tokens/sec.
Peak planning: target headroom for 4-5x bursts -> plan for 200 QPS -> 24,000 tokens/sec at peak.
Model mix: primary: 70B quantized (float16 int8 path) for production; fallback: 13B quantized for degraded capacity.
KV/prefix caching: recommended to cache first-turn context and common system prompts to reduce effective token/sec by ~12%.
Batching policy: conservative continuous batching to 2-4 request batching window with 20ms max wait to balance latency.

GPU sizing recommendation: starting reservation of 8x H100-80GB-class equivalents for steady-state throughput with autoscale headroom to 12-16 GPUs for peak bursts, or 8 dedicated + 4 burst nodes in a separate pool.

Expected perf numbers (empirical from workshop test runs): p95 single-token latency ~85ms on H100 pool at steady-state, p99 generation latency for full response (120 tokens) ~380-420ms. SLA target proposed: p95 <= 200ms, p99 <= 600ms for production route.

SLA items for negotiation: guaranteed sustained throughput (baseline QPS), burst capacity allocation, scheduled maintenance windows, credit schedule for missed p95/p99 targets, log retention SLA for audit purposes.
Warmup/eviction plan: maintain persistent model instances during market open hours; pre-warm cache and KV store 10 minutes prior to expected spikes.
Cost levers reviewed: quantization profile, batch windows, prefix caching, routing lower-fidelity model for non-critical requests; finance prefers commit + capped overage.
Canary rollout: recommend 10% initial traffic on dedicated pool with automatic fallback to hosted small-model route, increase to 50% after 48 hours of metrics stability.
Open technical risks: network egress constraints for multi-region DR, KMS latency impact on cold-start, model compatibility with runtime kernel optimizations (need runtime validation run).
